1. Find the gray object. We expect it to be unique: scene --> filter_color_gray --> unique
2. Find all objects with the same shape but made of matte or metal: result from step 1 --> same_material --> same_shape (and I call it with a temporary result 6) as 6 --> filter_html_material --> 7
3. Find only the matte (or metal) objects a same shape as the gray object: result from step 2 -- exclude the result from step 1  6 --> same_shape
